description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to certificate proof verification in Chromium's QUIC implementation, including ProofVerifierChromium and associated details structures.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium
classes.description: Implementation-specific proof verification details including certificate verification result, pinning failure log, and flags for PKP bypass and fatal errors.

classes.name: ProofVerifyContextChromium
classes.description: Context information for proof verification, including verification flags and logging source.

classes.name: ProofVerifierChromium
classes.description: Implements the QUIC ProofVerifier interface, handling multiple simultaneous proof verification requests with dependencies on certificate verification, security policies, and logging.

methods.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium
methods.description: Constructor, copy constructor, destructor, and clone method for proof verification details.

methods.name: ProofVerifyContextChromium
methods.description: Constructor initializing verification flags and logging context.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium
methods.description: Constructor initializing verifier with dependencies; deleted copy constructor and assignment; destructor.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies a proof for a given hostname, port, and other parameters asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default proof verification context.

methods.name: OnJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification job.
